Creative thinking.
An eye for the details.
about_paragraphs: I’m Tammy, a graphic designer and production specialist based in Cincinnati, Ohio. My work spans book publishing, print design, and marketing materials—bringing together considered layouts and careful attention to the finished piece.

From a book jacket’s foil separations to a multi-page brochure, I enjoy the intersection of creativity and precision. I work in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator to bring each piece from layout to production.
contact_note: Have an opportunity in mind? I’d love to hear from you.
